description: Prepare monthly pay apps from the schedule of values; submit to owners and federal invoicing portals; apply cash receipts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $2.25M billed a month; a missed pay app cycle delays cash by a month; misdirected payments are usually unrecoverable (FAR 52.232-33(e)(2) for federal EFT); owner trust
manual_workaround: Prepare pay apps from the last ERP export and spreadsheets; submit on paper or through owner portals; confirm remittance details by phone
dependent_third_parties: ERP vendor; owners; federal paying offices; bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Accounting Manager; Project Managers; main office

description: Approve invoices against pay apps; build ACH batches; release payments; collect lien waivers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1.6M a month to 120 subcontractors; federal jobs require payment within 7 days of receipt (FAR 52.232-27(c)(1)) with interest penalties; late payment can trigger liens and stop work
manual_workaround: Bank portal manual ACH from the last approved batch; checks with positive pay; phone verification of any changed bank details

description: Drawings, RFIs, submittals, and change orders for 8 jobsites through SYS-01
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Crews build from current drawings; working from superseded sheets causes rework and safety issues; RFI and submittal response times are contractual
manual_workaround: Printed current sets in each trailer; phone and email RFIs logged for later entry
dependent_third_parties: Project management platform vendor; design teams; cellular carriers

description: Takeoffs, pricing, subcontractor bid leveling, and proposal submission (including federal bids)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bid due times are fixed and late bids are rejected; one lost bid can be several million dollars of work; MTD applies during bid weeks
manual_workaround: Estimate from the prior day's database export and spreadsheets; hand-deliver or upload the bid from any device
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; AI bid assistant vendor (optional)

description: Weekly craft payroll, biweekly salaried payroll, and weekly certified payroll submissions for federal jobs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Craft are paid weekly; FAR 52.222-8(b)(1) requires weekly certified payrolls; missed pay harms workers and retention
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll vendor's support line; prepare certified payrolls from time records

description: Daily logs, safety inspections, time capture, and inspection scheduling
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Daily logs and safety records are contract deliverables; time capture feeds payroll
manual_workaround: Paper daily logs and time sheets; enter later
dependent_third_parties: Project management platform vendor; time-clock service

description: Install and configure client video surveillance, access control, and network equipment; hand over credentials
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Commissioning dates tie to owner move-in; client credentials must be available during warranty
manual_workaround: Delay commissioning; use manufacturer reset procedures with the client present
dependent_systems: SYS-06 file share; SYS-08 commissioning laptops; SYS-05

description: Track location, hours, and maintenance for 35 pieces of heavy equipment
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Maintenance intervals and theft recovery; not time-critical
manual_workaround: Paper hour logs; superintendents confirm locations by phone
